wholeCurrentGoals.title: Potenzialmessungen planen und auswerten
wholeCurrentGoals.description: Die lernende Person kann Messungen von Ruhe- und Aktionspotenzial planen und auswerten.
wholeCurrentGoals.descriptionEn: The learner can plan and evaluate measurements of resting and action potentials.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Potenzialmessungen planen und auswerten
resourceLinks.description: Modellhafte Illustration: Potenzialmessungen planen und auswerten.
resourceLinks.altText: Qualitative Potenzialmessung am Axon: Die innere Elektrode führt zum Plus-Eingang, die äußere Bezugselektrode zum Minus-Eingang. Das Messgerät bildet innen minus außen ab; die Modellkurve zeigt negative Ausgangslage und einen AP-Ausschlag.

wholeCurrentGoals.title: Plastische Verbindungsänderungen an gegebenen Netzmodellen erklären
wholeCurrentGoals.titleEn: Explain plastic connection changes in supplied network models
wholeCurrentGoals.description: Die lernende Person kann an gegebenen neuronalen Netzwerkmodellen erklären, wie Änderungen wirksamer Verbindungen die Verarbeitung gleicher Eingangssignale verändern.
wholeCurrentGoals.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied neural network models to explain how changes in effective connections alter the processing of identical input signals.
wholeCurrentGoals.sourceRef: Hessen: Kerncurriculum gymnasiale Oberstufe Biologie 2024, Q2.3, S. 43, zelluläre Prozesse des Lernens (Leistungskurs); Bayern: LehrplanPLUS Gymnasium Biologie 13, erhöhtes Anforderungsniveau, Lernbereich 2, funktionelle und strukturelle neuronale Plastizität. Didaktische Modellspezialisierung: plastische Änderungen wirksamer Netzverbindungen.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Plastische Verbindungsänderungen an gegebenen Netzmodellen erklären
resourceLinks.description: Modellhafte Illustration: Plastische Verbindungsänderungen an gegebenen Netzmodellen erklären.
resourceLinks.altText: Ein gegebenes Netzmodell mit je zwei Eingangsneuronen und einem Ausgangsneuron zeigt bei gleichem Eingang eine andere Antwort nach Änderung einer wirksamen synaptischen Verbindung. Struktur und Richtung des Netzes bleiben erhalten.

boundaries.sourceCourseScope: B13 GA and EA; repository projection GK_LK

primaryEvidence.finding: The Ruhepotential content component explicitly includes Potentialmessungen; it includes resting-potential generation and maintenance too.
The same resting-potential measurement component occurs at the increased level.

The methods section requires hypothesis-directed planning with variable control and collection/evaluation of qualitative and quantitative data; the increased-level section 313320 repeats these operators.

primaryEvidence.authoredLocator: LB2 content list position 4 in both GA/EA
primaryEvidence.finding: The adjacent action-potential component includes ion movement, temporal course, refractory phases, all-or-none principle and stimulus encoding. This supports contextual action-potential data treatment, with the measurement-planning combination still an authored didactic operationalisation.

boundaries.substantiveRationale: The complete current goal asks only for planning and evaluating resting/action potential recordings. It is compatible with the observed BY measurement content plus process operators and nearby action-potential time-course context. A direct partial source route accurately records this limited relationship. Exact source closure would misstate the goal: it neither covers the complete Ruhepotential content component nor proves all action-potential mechanisms, and the specific combined competency is not a literal official BY item. The existing BY assignment cannot be justified solely through the Q2.3 cluster or broad capstone prerequisite closure. Neither consumer satisfies the native ordinary-atomic surrogate requirements. Keep the candidate bounded extraction and partial mapping without a surrogate, exception, override, or whole-goal approval.

primaryEvidence.finding: Q2.3 puts Potenzialmessungen under grundlegendes Niveau (Grundkurs und Leistungskurs). Its separate cellular-learning component is under erhoehtes Niveau (Leistungskurs), alongside advanced synaptic integration.

The EA original requires explaining plasticity as a condition for learning and names functional and structural neuronal plasticity. This corroborates the specialist context; it does not turn the narrower supplied-network model into whole-source coverage.

boundaries.wholeLegacySourceFinding: The retained extraction is an authored composite about integration, learning and network wiring, labels itself GK_LK and officialCompetency, and uses the authored Q2.3.3 locator. The original HE43 does not contain that combined sentence as an official bullet. Its historical metadata is not evidence of official GK scope.
boundaries.wholeCurrentGoalFinding: The current target is LK-only and asks for an explanation within supplied models of how effective connection changes alter processing of identical inputs. This is a narrower authored model specialisation. It does not demonstrate the full biological cellular-learning component, all functional and structural plasticity, or all parts of the retained integration/learning/wiring composite.
boundaries.substantiveRationale: Each of the seven current exact composite-to-target edges overclaims identity and would require both GK and LK despite the actual current target being LK-only. Changing precisely those edges and decisions to partial, with an explicit LK limitation and intact archived originals, accurately represents the remaining specialist link. Merely adding a new partial review would leave the old exact live edges misleading and fail the native course-level rule. No reviewed course-level exception or target-course override is warranted. Native skipping of partial edges is technically appropriate only because the independently reviewed relation is substantively partial. The source extraction itself remains historical authored metadata, not a corrected official inventory or a closed source component.
